name: npc_kenshi-guard-01
customDialogue: The lake is calm. The gate is calm. Be calm.

name: npc_kenshi-villager-01
customDialogue:
I saw something in a broken stone once.
I still dream about it.

name: npc_kenshi-scholar-01
customDialogue:
Every duel since the founding is written here.
The last ten all mention tremors.

name: npc_kenshi-trainee-01
customDialogue:
Breathe in. Cut on the breath out.
Everything else is noise.

name: npc_kenshi-smith-01
customDialogue:
I scrape red off the blades every morning.
It comes back every night.

spotConfig.label: Look at the cut
spotConfig.text: In the deepest cut of the post runs a thin red line, as if the wood had bled metal.

spotConfig.label: Look at the cut
spotConfig.text: This post too. The red line follows the grain down into the ground.

spotConfig.label: Hold your stance
spotConfig.text: The ground rolls under the stone. You breathe out, and stay. When it passes, your feet have not moved.

spotConfig.label: Look at the stone
spotConfig.text: A boulder split clean in two by a single cut. The inside of this half is smooth and dark. The other half lies a few steps away.

spotConfig.label: Sketch the symbol
spotConfig.text: Inside the other half: a ring of roots around a closed eye, as if it had grown inside the stone. You copy it line by line.

spotConfig.label: Stand still by the lake
spotConfig.text: The ripples die away, one by one. When the lake is a perfect mirror, you see it: under the water a ring of stones, and in the middle a closed stone eye.

requires.hint: Only water and reeds. The Kenshi say the lake is worth seeing at sunrise.

spotConfig.text: The sun comes up over the far shore and the mist lifts off the lake in one long sheet, like a blade being drawn.

spotConfig.label: Sit at the centre
spotConfig.text: At the heart of the raked ring the gravel is worn into a shallow seat. Sitting there, every line of the yard points at you, and the noise of the village goes quiet.

spotConfig.label: Look at the old blade
spotConfig.text: Leaning in the forge shadow: a blade with no maker's mark, older than the village. Its edge is perfect, and faintly red.

spotConfig.label: Listen down the well
spotConfig.text: Your voice goes down the well and comes back twice: once from the water, and once from much deeper.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.
